description: The correctness annotations read by the gate's concrete checks: schema profiles, point-in-time metadata, and M-10 grounding and read-authorization requirements. Only the named fields are constrained; a node may carry any other attributes.

as_of.description: The point-in-time cutoff for an ML step: every feature must be computed only from data available at or before this instant. ISO-8601 UTC date or date-time (e.g. "2024-01-01" or "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Required when `features` is present.

audio_local_only.description: Audio samples remain on their owner node.

caller_read_required.description: Marks a source whose selected columns all require caller read access.

citations_required.description: Requires every grounded-answer sentence to cite retrieved evidence.

consent_column.description: The boolean source field that records speech-processing consent.

consent_required.description: Speech transcription must require explicit source consent.

features.description: The features an ML step consumes. Each is checked for point-in-time and target leakage against `as_of` / `label`.

data_as_of.description: The latest instant of data this feature draws on. If it is after the step's `as_of` cutoff, the feature leaks future data (a point-in-time violation). Same ISO-8601 UTC format as `as_of`.

derived_from.description: What the feature is computed from. The literal "label", or the `label` column name, marks the feature as target leakage.

leaks_target.description: Explicit marker that the feature encodes the target — target leakage.

governance_check.description: Requires runtime authorization before language training reads text.

label.description: The name of the target/label column the model predicts. Used to detect target leakage (a feature that is, or is derived from, the label).

outcome.description: The binary observed-outcome column for an uplift model.

redact_pii.description: Speech transcript text is privacy-filtered before durable storage.

refuse_without_retrieval.description: Requires the language path to refuse when no relevant chunk was retrieved.

requires.description: The fields this step EXPECTS from its data-flow inputs and the type each must have. Each is checked against the merged `schema` of the step's transitive data-flow ancestors: a missing field or a type mismatch fails the schema_type check.

schema.description: The fields this step OUTPUTS and their types — a source profile for a Connect step, the transformed shape for a Clean step. Field name -> type token (an opaque string, compared case-insensitively).

source_column.description: The camera, site, document, or other source-group column used for a vision holdout.

source_disjoint.description: Vision models must split whole source groups between train and test.

treatment.description: The binary treatment-assignment column for an uplift model.

treatment_time.description: The treatment instant; causal features with data_as_of after it are post-treatment and refused.
